name: Worldwide Banking Symbol adopted after the merger of Chase and the Bank of the Manhattan Company
description: In March 1951, the bank adopted the worldwide banking symbol; after the merger of Chase and the Bank of the Manhattan Company, the wording on the worldwide symbol was changed to read "The Chase Manhattan Bank" and the line "Chartered 1799" was added at the bottom.
citation: Phillip Towns, 2013, "Worldwide Banking Symbol adopted after the merger of Chase and the Bank of the Manhattan Company", https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/23131, Harvard Dataverse, V1
